SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Facility: Harborview Endoscopy Center (fictional)
Patient: Teodor Lindqvist (fictional)
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: Naomi Carrow, MD (fictional)
Indication: Hematochezia.
Procedure: The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum; the appendiceal orifice was identified.
Findings:
- Mid transverse colon: a 30 mm flat, granular laterally spreading lesion.
- The lesion was not removed today because clopidogrel had not been held.
- Today a submucosal tattoo was placed 3 cm distal to the lesion for future localization.
- The tattoo used sterile carbon particle suspension injected in three quadrants.
- Remainder of the colon: normal.
Impression:
1. 30 mm laterally spreading lesion of the transverse colon, tattooed today; not resected.
Plan: Endoscopic mucosal resection at a separate session after clopidogrel is held.
